questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion appropriately to emphasize the adverbial phrase 'Only when the deadline approached'.
options: Only when the deadline approached, he submitted his report.
Only when the deadline approached did he submit his report.
Only when the deadline approached, did he submit his report.
Only when the deadline approached, he had submitted his report.
questions.answer: Only when the deadline approached did he submit his report.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific location where the incident occurred?
options: It was in the old warehouse that the fire started.
It was the old warehouse where the fire started.
The fire started in the old warehouse, that place.
The old warehouse was where the fire started.
questions.answer: It was in the old warehouse that the fire started.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly employs the third type of conditional sentence (irrealis present) to discuss hypothetical present situations.
options: If I knew her number, I would call her now.
If I had known her number, I would have called her.
If I knew her number, I would have called her.
If I knew her number, I would call her tomorrow.
questions.answer: If I knew her number, I would call her tomorrow.

questions.question: Which sentence accurately uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement?
options: I suggest that he attends the conference.
It is recommended that he attends the conference.
He is recommended to attend the conference.
The conference recommends that he attends.
questions.answer: It is recommended that he attends the conference.

questions.question: Identify the correct instance of ellipsis where the word 'are' is omitted from the second clause to maintain parallel structure in a formal document.
options: The committee members are expected to submit their reports by Friday; the same is the teachers.
The committee members are expected to submit their reports by Friday; the same is the teachers to do.
The committee members are expected to submit their reports by Friday; the same is the teachers, expected to do.
The committee members are expected to submit their reports by Friday; the same is the teachers, are expected to do.
questions.answer: The committee members are expected to submit their reports by Friday; the same is the teachers to do.
